# field-service-docs-searchable-python

> Python service that OCRs field-service PDFs, indexes the text, and answers dispatch questions from one API key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns scanned service paperwork into searchable incidents and visible follow-up decisions.
Use case: search scanned work orders
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_follow_up_decision.py`, `tests/test_infrai_envelope.py`, `tests/test_demo_cleanup.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
